title: City Boosts Austin's Sewer Infrastructure
summary:
*   City officials approved an $800 appropriation for new public works.
*   This funding will construct a 1250-foot, 6-inch sanitary sewer line in areas near 29th and 30th streets.
*   The project includes the addition of two manholes and a new flush tank to improve the city's sewage system.
transcript:
742
.Regular meeting of the City Council : Austin,Texas : March 15, 1917: The Council was
called to order by Mayor pro tem Powell,Roll called: Present Councilmen Anthony,
Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 4
Absent Mayor Wooldridge 1.

The minutes of the last regular and subsequent recessed meetings were read and adopted:

Councilman Haynes presented the report of the Sanitary Inspector for the months of January
& February 1917, which was read and ordered filed: Councilman Powell offered the following
resolution : Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin,Texas:

That the sum of $ 800.00, be and the same is hereby appropriated out of the Sanitary Sewer
fund to pay for a a line of 6 inch sewer 1250 feet in lengh beginning at the intersection
of 30th street ,extending southward to 29th NXXX street,thence westward on 29th street to
the alley between Guadalupe and Rio Grande streets ,thence southward through said alley to
a point 100 feet north of 28th street and including the construction of two manholes and a
flush tank.

The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew,
Haynes & Powell 4
Absent Mayor Wooldridge 1
Approved, P W Powell, Mayor pro tem
The Council then adjourned.
